decisions.question: Which animation library should we use for the hero section?
decisions.context: The hero section needs smooth entrance animations and scroll-triggered effects. Framer Motion integrates well with React but adds ~30kb. CSS-only is lighter but harder to maintain complex sequences.

decisions.question: What tone should the launch blog post use?
decisions.context: Our target audience is technical founders and solo developers. The tone will set expectations for all future content. Competitors tend toward corporate language.
